name: submit_sound
description:
Generate a new sound effect with ElevenLabs and create an audio asset in the project library.

Do not use this for ordinary editing SFX that may already exist in ChatCut Sound Effects, such as whoosh, riser, impact, notification, click, ding, censor beep, record scratch, camera shutter, keyboard typing, or reaction sounds. For those, first call browse_library with category:"sound-effects", then place the returned library:sound id with edit_item. Use submit_sound only when the user explicitly asks to generate/original/custom audio, or when browse_library cannot find a suitable existing sound.

This tool does not place or replace timeline items; after the job completes, use track_progress to get the asset id and edit_item to place it.

External MCP spend rule: this tool costs ChatCut credits and starts an async generation job. Only call it when the user's request or confirmation clearly covers this exact generation; do not silently create extra variants, longer durations, higher quality, or additional outputs.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

prompt.description: Describe the sound (e.g. "Thunder and heavy rain", "Door creaking open").

promptInfluence.description: 0–1, default 0.3. Higher = stricter prompt adherence, lower = more model variation.
